name: Intel Gaudi 2
memory_bandwidth_basis: Vendor-published per-accelerator figure from the Gaudi 3 technical paper's Gaudi 2 vs Gaudi 3 comparison table: 96 GB HBM2e at 2.46 TB/s.
notes: Numbers are taken from the Gaudi 3 technical paper's comparison table, since Intel never published a standalone Gaudi 2 datasheet that is reachable; treat them as vendor-published but second-hand. The third flops row is BF16 VECTOR TFLOPS (112), a different unit to the first two (MME TFLOPS 432) and therefore NOT a contradiction - it is recorded separately rather than merged, with vendor_claim false to flag that it is a different quantity. On-die SRAM is 48 MB at 6.4/6.4 TB/s, half of Gaudi 3. 2 MME units and 24 TPC units. 600 GB/s bidirectional networking versus Gaudi 3's 1200. Host interface is PCIe Gen4 x16 at 64 GB/s peak versus Gaudi 3's PCIe Gen5 at 128. Included as a separate record because it remains in cloud and OEM fleets and because the architectural delta (SRAM tier, MME/TPC split, die count) is what makes the Gaudi 3 comparison meaningful. Still shipping in Intel's own and OEM racks and on IBM Cloud / AWS DL1.
